I have farmed this land for over forty years, and I know the soil is tired, so I will apply some NPK fertilizer from the government subsidy program and spread manure from my livestock to help the sorghum grow stronger. I have kept my own seed from last year’s harvest, and my sons and grandchildren will provide most of the labor weeding and harvesting on this plot. I cannot afford chemicals for sorghum, and there is no water to irrigate here, but I may pay a few young men from the village to help with the heavy work at harvest time when the millet is also ready.
